name: Llama 4 Maverick

sources.locator: model page and access request form

lifecycle.note: Open weights still offered (gated, on request) from Meta's meta-llama organisation on Hugging Face and from Meta's Llama 4 page on 2026-10-01. The hosted Llama API preview is a separate matter, see notes.

relations.note: Editorial link along the Llama line: Llama 4 Maverick is among the first Llama 4 models, released after Llama 3.3, and the announcement compares its price and quality with Llama 3.3 70B. Meta does not call it the successor of a named model.

sources.locator: Pushing Llama to new sizes: The 2T Behemoth

relations.note: Meta describes this as codistillation, with Llama 4 Behemoth as the teacher model.

summary.text: Llama 4 Maverick is a multimodal language model in Meta's Llama 4 line that takes text and images and returns text, released with open weights in BF16 and FP8 and later offered in a preview of Meta's Llama API. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 17B of 400B parameters active and a 1M-token context length; Meta calls it its product workhorse for assistant and chat use.

changes.text: One of Meta's first Llama models built on mixture of experts: 128 routed experts plus a shared expert in alternating dense and MoE layers, 17B of 400B parameters active.
Accepts images alongside text as input; Meta describes native multimodality with early fusion of text and vision tokens.
Context length of 1M tokens, up from 128K in Llama 3.
Codistilled from Llama 4 Behemoth as teacher, then post-trained with lightweight supervised fine-tuning, online reinforcement learning and lightweight DPO.

inputModalities.note: Meta's docs give text plus up to 5 images as input; the model card says image understanding was tested up to 5 input images and the docs say image understanding is English-only.

outputModalities.note: The docs say text-only output; the model card table lists the output as multilingual text and code.

sources.locator: Introduction, feature table, Maximum Context Length

contextWindowTokens.note: The announcement gives no context length for Maverick.

parameters.note: Mixture-of-experts model with 128 routed experts and a shared expert in alternating dense and MoE layers; the value is the total parameter count, of which 17B are active per token.

openWeights.note: Gated download under the Llama 4 Community License Agreement, a custom commercial license (model card); released as BF16 and FP8 weights.

access.note: API access through Meta's Llama API, a limited free preview announced on 2025-04-29. The launch post said partner availability would follow in the coming days; cloud-partner is left out because no Meta source read here names the partners.

notes: Released together with Llama 4 Scout in the post The Llama 4 herd, which also previewed Llama 4 Behemoth. Pretrained and instruction-tuned versions were published (Hugging Face meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E, meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct and an FP8 build of the instruction-tuned model; original-format checkpoints in the matching -Original repositories). The announcement mentions an experimental chat version of Maverick evaluated on LMArena; it was not released as a separate model and is not recorded. The announcement says Meta AI in WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram Direct and on the web is built with Llama 4 without naming the model, so consumer-app is left out. Meta later wound down the hosted Llama API: its page Upcoming changes to Llama API (https://llama.developer.meta.com/docs/llama-api-deprecation/) now redirects to dev.meta.ai and shows only a sign-in prompt, and the Internet Archive holds only a redirect capture (20260911184803), so no end date is recorded.
